candidate.answerReason: Sorting by shape means choosing shape as the sorting criterion, so A is correct.

methods.label: Identify the sorting criterion
methods.explanation: Different criteria can produce different groups. To sort buttons by shape, first choose shape as the sorting criterion. The answer is A: The sorting criterion.
methods.levelReason: Choosing a sorting criterion is within Grade 2 classification knowledge.
